Hi team,

Draft term sheet attached — Azure_Private_Plan_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf. Key commercial points I propose:
- Pricing cap: $120k ARR (12-month private plan) with a 60% utilization threshold before true-up.
- Monthly invoicing; 30-day payment terms.
- SLA: 99.5% uptime standard for private plan; credits per downtime window (standard Redwood language).
- Co-sell: Redwood will opt into Microsoft co-sell; will complete Partner Center consent and provide any required co-sell SKU mapping.

I also attached the last redlined MSA we've used for Marketplace private offers: Redwood_MSA_redline_20261127.docx. Rishi — flagged a few clauses that might need legal attention (see comments in the doc): data residency reference, audit rights, and a tightened liability cap if customer pushes.

From: Michael Huang <michael.huang@microsoft.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 07:35:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Azure Marketplace private plan — request: pricing cap, co-sell consent

Hi Vanessa/Elena,

Quick note on co-sell: to be eligible for the commercial marketplace co-sell program you’ll need to complete two steps — (1) offer submission as a private plan in Partner Center and (2) a co-sell consent form that the customer signs in Partner Center (they can delegate to the ISV). I’ve pasted the partner flow here: https://partner.microsoft.com/en-us/dashboard/commercialmarketplace/offer/submit.

If you want, we can do a short onboarding call with the Partner Center team to walk through the consent flow next week. From an eligibility perspective, the term sheet you outlined is typical; Microsoft will want to ensure the SKU mapping and pricing fields are set in submission.

Cheers,
Michael Huang
Partner PM, Microsoft Commercial Marketplace

Procurement is comfortable with the pricing cap otherwise and asked to move to DocuSign for signature.

Attachments: BlueKey_redlines_20261130.docx

If Redwood can accept the liability tweak and onboarding credit, procurement will sign this week and we can start the Partner Center steps.

—Elena

  - Confirm data residency: US-only deployment available; ops to document region and backup controls.

Marcus/Rishi — please prepare an execution-ready DocuSign packet with updated liability wording, the onboarding credit amendment, and the Partner Center enrollment instructions. Marcus: copy the HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/BK-7421) and set renewal notification for 90 days prior to term end.
